issues.issue: Whether CBSA airport questioning without notice of right to counsel can be relied on
issues.applicant_position: Minister says the cited case postdates the 2014 interview and does not invalidate current law.
issues.respondent_position: Airport questioning was a hearing; without notice of right to counsel the answers must be excluded.
issues.result_text: CBSA Officer and Hearings Advisor questions and answers not considered; right to counsel not made clear.

issues.issue: Whether the remaining evidence shows the Minister's case that the claimant was a refugee claimant
issues.applicant_position: Returning on a Honduran passport after refugee status suffices for a prima facie cessation case.
issues.respondent_position: Excluding the interview leaves the Minister with no basis for the cessation request.
issues.result_text: Minister lacked admissible evidence that the CBSA officer knew the claimant was a past refugee.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant voluntarily re-availed himself of Honduran protection (s.108(1)(a))
issues.applicant_position: Passports, five returns and no clandestine conduct show intent to avail of Honduran protection.
issues.respondent_position: Returns were compelled by family circumstances, not voluntary; he never sought Honduran authorities' protection.
issues.result_text: Minister did not meet the onus to show voluntary re-availment of Honduran protection.
